description: The limits Ballistic enforces for one launchpad and pair: how many wallets hold the supply after a launch, holder wallets and each one’s share of supply, wallets in the launch itself, supply range, largest buy, per mode (Block-0 and Reserve). Call list_launchpads_and_pairs first for the launchpad ids. An unknown launchpad is refused. Read-only.

pair.description: What the token is paired with, for example SOL, USDC or a stock symbol. Omit for the chain’s own coin.

venue.description: Launchpad id or name: pumpfun, stonkfun, flap or pons.

name: get_limits
title: Launch limits
